I need to analyze the high-speed rail options departing from Beijing's southern station on March 10, 2026, to help our team choose the best route for an upcoming business trip. Please query the rail system to retrieve all trains whose departure station is Beijing South Railway Station (北京南站, telecode VNP) and whose departure date is 2026-03-10. Do NOT include trains departing from any other Beijing station (such as Beijing Railway Station/BJP, Beijing West/VAP, or Beijing North/BOP) — Beijing South (VNP) only. The destination stations are not pre-specified: to retrieve all trains departing from Beijing South on that date, you must enumerate candidate destination stations yourself and query Beijing South → each candidate station, then aggregate the results into one set. Important: a city-level lookup may return a representative station that differs from the actual arrival station — for example, a train arrives at 上海虹桥/SHH (Shanghai Hongqiao), not 上海/AOH (Shanghai). Enumerate by specific station code rather than by city name, otherwise trains will be missed. The rail system's full set of station telecodes is: BJP, VNP, VAP, BOP, AOH, SHH, GZQ, GGQ, SZQ, IOQ, CDW, WEI, XIY, EAY, WHN, WGQ, NJH, NKH, HGH, HHH, TJP, TJN, SYT, SYB, ZZF, ZGE, CSQ, CWQ, KMM, KMY, QFB. Query Beijing South (VNP) → each of these telecodes in turn (use the get-station-by-telecode / station-lookup tooling with from_telecode=VNP and the candidate as the destination, filtered to depart_date 2026-03-10) and keep every train returned. This set of trains is the complete scope of the entire analysis below (Excel, Word report, and email). Note the key details for each route.

Create an Excel workbook called Route_Analysis.xlsx in the workspace. Add a sheet called Routes with one row per available train departing from Beijing South on 2026-03-10, using the following columns: Train_Code, Destination, Depart_Time, Arrive_Time, Duration_Min (the journey duration expressed in whole minutes as an integer), First_Class_Price, Second_Class_Price, Available_Second_Class_Seats. First_Class_Price is the price of the first-class seat (一等座) and Second_Class_Price is the price of the second-class seat (二等座); do not use the business-class (商务座) price for these two columns. Use the ticket price exactly as returned by the rail system — it is already the final price, so do not apply any additional discount on top of it. Sort the rows by departure time from earliest to latest. The Available_Second_Class_Seats column should show the actual seat availability value from the rail system (which may be a number or a text indicator).

Add a second sheet called Summary with columns Label and Value. Include the following rows in this order: Total_Routes (the total number of trains found), Earliest_Departure (the departure time of the first train), Latest_Departure (the departure time of the last train), Cheapest_Second_Class (the train code of the train with the lowest second class price), Fastest_Route (the train code of the train with the shortest duration in minutes), Most_Available_Seats (the train code of the train that shows the highest numeric seat availability or the most generous availability indicator for second class).

Then write a Word analysis report called Route_Analysis_Report.docx in the workspace. The document should have four sections with headings. The first section heading is "Executive Summary" and should be a short paragraph summarizing the number of routes found, the date, and a general observation about the options. The second section heading is "Route Details" and should have one paragraph per available train covering its code, destination, schedule, duration, and pricing for both seat classes. The third section heading is "Recommendation" and should identify the single best train for a business trip that prioritizes speed, with justification based on journey duration. The fourth section heading is "Cost Comparison" and should compare the ticket prices across all routes and seat classes.

Finally, send an email to logistics@company.com with the subject "Beijing Train Route Analysis 2026-03-10". The email body should contain the key summary figures: number of routes, the recommended train code, its departure and arrival times, and the second class prices for all available trains.

你是只读探索子代理（web-domain-researcher）。任务：查询12306余票系统，获取 2026-03-10 从北京南站出发、到达站 telecode 为 XIY 的所有列车信息。

执行步骤：
1. 调用 mcp__rail_12306__get-station-by-telecode(stationTelecode="XIY") 获取该目的站的官方站名 station_name。
2. 调用 mcp__rail_12306__get-tickets(date="2026-03-10", fromStation="VNP", toStation="XIY") 查询余票。不要设置 limitedNum 截断（保持默认），不要设置 trainFilterFlags（查全部车次），不要调用 get-interline-tickets。
3. 逐列车提取并返回以下字段：
   - 车次 train_code（如 G11，用显示车次即可）
   - 实际出发站名 + telecode（应为 北京南/VNP）
   - 实际到达站名 + telecode（必须用接口返回的实际到达站，例如 上海虹桥/SHH，严禁用城市代表站如 上海/AOH 代替）
   - 出发时间（HH:MM）与到达时间（HH:MM）
   - 历时 duration（如 05:31）
   - 一等座价格（元）及该座位余票状态
   - 二等座价格（元）及该座位余票状态（原样保留可用性文字，如“有票”“无票”“剩余N张票”等，不要换算）
4. 若查询结果为空或没有列车，明确输出“无列车”。

约束：只查询 XIY 这一个目的站，不扩展到其他站；只读操作，不要写任何文件、不调用任何写工具；不要编造数据，所有数字必须以接口返回为准。最后以清晰的结构化文本逐列车返回全部信息（每条列车一行或一个条目）。
